headline_marked: NBR [[raids 4 establishments including Fu-Wang bar]] over tax evasion
headline: NBR raids 4 establishments including Fu-Wang bar over tax evasion
summary: The Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) targeted bars and restaurants in Dhaka, alleging illegal alcohol sourcing and duty evasion.
details: The Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) conducted a "special operation" targeting four establishments in Dhaka, including the Fu-Wang Bowling and Services bar.
Other targets included Canvas Restaurant, Habib Hotel International, and Margarita Lounge. The operation was coordinated by several agencies of the National Board of Revenue (NBR).
The raids were triggered by allegations that these establishments obtained alcohol from illegal sources, evaded customs duty, VAT, and income tax, and supplied them to unauthorized customers.

In a related action, the CIID and other agencies raided and sealed four warehouses at Toss Bond Private Ltd in South Gulshan, including two that were allegedly storing duty-free liquor without authorization.

The investigation into liquor and bar businesses has accelerated following recent public claims made by content creator Salman Muqtadir, who is the son-in-law of Sheikh Nur Islam, the owner of Fu-Wang.
Fu-Wang has denied the allegations, stating that Sheikh Nur Islam and his family have no relationship with Toss Bond and have severed all ties with Salman Muqtadir and his wife, Disha Islam.

headline_marked: 70 rescued as [[Gazipur garment factory fire tamed]] after 3.5 hours
headline: 70 rescued as Gazipur garment factory fire tamed after 3.5 hours
summary: Nine fire service units battled a blaze at Matrix Styles Limited, struggling with a lack of of water sources and on-site firefighting systems.
details: A massive fire broke out at the Matrix Styles Limited garment factory in Gazipur on Saturday afternoon, leaving 70 people rescued from the building.
The blaze started around 2:45 PM near Fakir Market of Gazi Degir Chala and intensified quickly, requiring nine units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence to bring it under control by 6:00 PM.
Firefighters faced significant challenges as the factory lacked its own firefighting system and there were no ponds or water sources nearby to combat the flames.
The fire erupted on the third floor of the seven-storey building, which served as a fabric warehouse, complicating the efforts to fully douse the fire.
According to Fire Service Deputy Director Salauddin Ahmed, crews are still working to clear out fabric stocks piece by piece to ensure the fire is completely extinguished.
Officials are currently investigating whether anyone was injured or killed in the incident, while a detailed inquiry will determine the cause of the fire and any safety lapses.
caption:
70 people rescued from a seven-storey garment factory in Gazipur as nine fire units battle a massive blaze.

A massive fire broke out at the Matrix Styles Limited garment factory in Gazipur on Saturday afternoon, leaving 70 people rescued from the building.

The blaze started around 2:45 PM near Fakir Market of Gazi Degir Chala and intensified quickly, requiring nine units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence to bring it under control by 6:00 PM.

Firefighters faced significant challenges as the factory lacked its own firefighting system and there were no ponds or water sources nearby to combat the flames.

The fire erupted on the third floor of the seven-storey building, which served as a fabric warehouse, complicating the efforts to fully douse the fire.

According to Fire Service Deputy Director Salauddin Ahmed, crews are still working to clear out fabric stocks piece by piece to ensure the fire is completely extinguished.

Officials are currently investigating whether anyone was injured or killed in the incident, while a detailed inquiry will determine the cause of the fire and any safety lapses.
